title: NetworkPolicy silently drops traffic from the calling service

root_cause.summary: NetworkPolicy restrict-inventory-ingress only allows ingress from pods labelled app=billing, so traffic from storefront (app=storefront) to inventory is dropped and times out.

required_evidence: NetworkPolicy restrict-inventory-ingress selects app=inventory and allows ingress only from app=billing
storefront pods are labelled app=storefront, which is not in the allowed list
storefront logs show timeouts (not connection refused or DNS errors)
red_herrings: inventory pods are Running and Ready, and the Service has endpoints
A timeout rather than 'connection refused' points to dropped packets, not a dead server
fix: Add a rule to the NetworkPolicy that allows ingress from app=storefront (or remove the policy if it was applied by mistake).
